title: TestConnectionResult
description: Outcome of providers.testConnection, which makes one real authenticated request to the provider. A failure is a result rather than a JSON-RPC error, because the interface has to show the provider's own wording alongside a translated headline.

succeeded.description: True when the provider accepted the credentials.

modelVerified.description: True when the configured model identifier was found among the models this key can reach. False with succeeded true means the key works but the model name is probably a typo.

availableModels.description: Model identifiers the provider reported, used both to verify the configured model and to populate suggestions. Empty when the provider exposes no model listing.

failureCode.description: Stable, lower_snake_case category of the failure, which the renderer resolves to a headline. Present only when succeeded is false.

providerMessage.description: The provider's own error text, verbatim except that the API key is scrubbed out of it. Shown as diagnostic detail beneath the translated headline, because a generic failure message is useless.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status code the provider returned, when the request reached it at all.
